controls.role_evidence: Frame 161/162 = universal close glyph (circular crossed-swords/X, green highlighted vs normal; npc-window-render-evidence.json visual inspection, high confidence). Same frame pair is the first control tested in chat hit dispatch 0x004149A0-0x00414C56 and a handled result returns immediately, matching a generic close route rather than a channel command. The pair is reused as the close/confirm control in 10+ window objects (status, inventory, social friend/guild, system options/horse/exchange, npc, notice, horse).

controls.note: created by a different constructor (0x00417960) than the shared 0x00417550 used for the other nine controls. Decoded on this pass: it is the shared vertical bar/gauge control — sprite GameInter frame 0x17C=380 (16x502), fill area 12x260, pad 12, mode 0=vertical — drawn at paint 0x00414846 with (window.x+0x215, window.y-0xD0, value=[this+0x68], max=[this+0x6D0]). Same control family as inventory this+0x278, store this+0x5FC, exchange this+0x13648/+0x13694, guild this+0x76C, HUD this+0x61BC and NPC this+0x3C4.

refresh.notes: The linked-line record stride is 16 bytes, but the paint loop advances the screen Y coordinate by 0x0E (14 pixels). Do not use the record stride as visual line spacing.

text_call_argument_flow.interpretation: The binary directly proves the chat paint call's text pointer, two node metadata values, screen coordinates, and shared renderer context. It does not prove the business meaning of node+0x00/node+0x04 or the renderer context's font/color table.

record_fields_resolved.node+0x04: background color; 0 = transparent (renderer bg arg -> SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT) path)
record_fields_resolved.node+0x08: inline text buffer pointer (renderer text arg -> strlen + TextOutA)

arg_roles.color: renderer color slot; chat passes node+0x00; other call sites push literal colors 0x323232 (dark gray), 0x0A0A0A (near-black), 0xB4FFB4 (pale green) -> SetTextColor
arg_roles.bg: renderer background slot; chat passes node+0x04; other call sites push 0 -> SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT) branch at 0x0045DDB1; nonzero -> SetBkColor
arg_roles.text: renderer text slot; chat passes node+0x08 -> strlen at 0x0045DDFC then TextOutA

text_renderer.caveat: color/bg/text relative order is consistent across all recovered call sites; the absolute x/y slot positions among the 7 stack args and the meaning of arg1 (0x008AB7C4) and arg7 (0) need one re-verification pass on the call site once the exe is available again.

shared_control_string_storage.copy_proof: The constructor copies the non-null string argument into control_object+0x34 after storing resource, position, state and mode fields.
shared_control_string_storage.chat_constructor_sources: The six calls at 0x00414155–0x00414219 pass the original GBK command/description string pointers; the corresponding control objects are this+0x120 through this+0x4A4.
shared_control_string_storage.interpretation: The six command strings are structurally bound to the six chat controls and are available to the shared control implementation during its draw/geometry path. The available static path does not yet prove whether the user sees them as captions, hover tooltips, or both; that display distinction remains pending.

original_command_strings.caveat: These are original command/tooltip strings supplied to the control constructors. They establish the six channel/command concepts and their fixed x positions, but the exact visible caption versus tooltip rendering still belongs to the shared control implementation.

paint_order.evidence: The chat paint entry first calls the window vtable +0x0C before text, controls or input geometry.
A fixed RECT is written at window-relative (25,311)-(524,326) before the visible history loop.
The visible linked records are traversed and emitted through 0x45DD70 at the recovered origin, with 19-row maximum and 14-pixel screen-line advance.

The this+0x6D4 bar draws at (window.x+0x215, window.y-0xD0) with value=[this+0x68] and max=[this+0x6D0]; sprite GameInter frame 380 (16x502), fill 12x260 vertical. This is the shared gauge/bar component, not a frame blit.

paint_order.role: scroll/channel control reposition and child paint
paint_order.evidence: The routine writes fixed relative positions for the close, six channel and two scroll controls, then calls nine child vtable +0x04 paint slots in sequence.
The final loop builds successive input-character rectangles from the input buffer with a 14-pixel horizontal progression.
